thread:
rachel: Heads-up: promote held. Artifact checksum mismatch detected after upload; several runners fail during pip install with truncated file extraction. Also seeing a flaky e2e that only fails on arm64 axis (seed=99).

omar: paste the installer log snippet?

rachel: build:wheel:linux-arm64 shows: 
```
Processing ./dist/redwood_cli-4.1.0-py3-none-manylinux2014_aarch64.whl
error: unexpected EOF while reading
Extraction failed: truncated wheel file
```

ci-worker: Confirmed: uploader reported sha256=ff11aa..., but downloaded artifact on registry returns sha256=ff11ab...; size differs by ~16KB. 4 runners across two regions observed same mismatch.

deploy-bot: Promotion blocked: reason="artifact-checksum-mismatch". Suggested fallback: pin to registry.redwood/ci-cache:2026-07-12-04 or wait for reupload. Change window ends in 1h 15m.

omar: Any uploader errors? multipart logs?

rachel: uploader logs show complete OK, but storage node logs indicate a brief write error during finalize and then retry. Replica sync may have returned an older partial object.

storage-eng: I'm on it. Opening INC-2026-200, investigating replica finalization and multipart complete path. Earliest suspect: storage node disk pressure caused a truncated commit. Kicking off object repair and rehydrate.

omar: There's also the arm flake (seed=99) which times out hitting the onboarding proxy. Likely caused by delayed extraction on affected runners. So both issues seem linked to truncated artifact.

rachel: Options: 1) pin to last-known-good image to keep the window, 2) rerun uploader + full matrix now (risk missing window), 3) wait for storage repair (ETA unknown). PM prefers to keep schedule if low risk.

omar: I support pin. We'll add a note in release that the cut was pinned due to artifact integrity issue and we'll re-run the matrix post-cut after reupload. Also will add a pipeline preflight to compare sha256 from uploader metadata vs downloaded object before pip install.

rachel: Agreed. I'll request manual approval and draft release-note text. Omar, can you open the PR for preflight checksum?

omar: Will open PR now. Suggest quick preflight script: curl -sSfL "$ARTIFACT_URL" -o /tmp/art && sha256sum /tmp/art | cut -d' ' -f1 | grep -qx "$UPLOADER_SHA" || exit 1

storage-eng: Incident INC-2026-200 created and assigned to storage. Repair job started; rehydrate progress 20% after 7m. Will post updates.

rachel: Decision: apply manual pin to registry.redwood/ci-cache:2026-07-12-04 to preserve change window; incident INC-2026-200 for artifact truncation; follow-ups: reupload artifact + rerun matrix after cut, add checksum preflight.

omar: +1

deploy-bot: Action executed: require_manual_approval=true; pinned_image=registry.redwood/ci-cache:2026-07-12-04; hold_reason=\"checksum-mismatch + arm64 seed=99 flake\".

storage-eng: will update INC-2026-200 as we progress.

rachel: TL;DR: manual pin to keep schedule; infra to repair and we will retry post-cut.
